note: Golden set v1 (design §24). Invented but realistic; replace and extend with anonymised pilot messages (target 50+). 'expect.lines' lists price-book items (by name prefix, from the electrical starter pack) that must be matched; 'expect.allow' lists items that are a fair match but not required. 'mustAsk' cases pass only if the model asks instead of guessing. Hours are never stated unless 'hoursStated' is true.
